reason: I don't install and babysit tools, and this is a GitHub project I'd have to set up and run on my own machine with a sandbox. Free doesn't help if it's on me to get it working right before the migration I've already put off a year.
objection: I don't trust an AI to decide what counts as the same behavior. If it writes the business rules and I just click confirm, I'm still the one on the hook when the client finds the thing it missed.
would_change_my_mind: Someone else running it for me, like a provider or a one-click app, plus seeing it catch a real regression on an app like mine that my own clicking around missed.
